title: Xianxia Aerial Duel: Talisman Master vs Sword Immortal (25s Chained Storyboard) / 古典仙俠・崇山空戰：符修與劍修巔峰對決 (25秒連貫分鏡)
description: 5-segment continuous high-energy Wuxia/Xianxia aerial duel over towering mountain peaks, featuring high-kinetic action verbs, supersonic camera dives, and anti-drift character anchor reset.

segments.title: Part 1 (0-5s): Cloud Sea Flight & Pursuit / 雲海疾飛・崇山掠影
segments.prompt: [Scene] Majestic sea of tumbling clouds rolling between colossal jagged karst mountain peaks at sunset, bathed in amber and crimson light. [Camera] High-speed aerial FPV tracking shot swooping low between vertical cliff faces, chasing the flying cultivators. Timeline: 0-2.5s: Talisman cultivator in fluttering indigo silk robes with gold embroidery soars through mist, ribbons dancing violently in slipstream. 2.5-5.0s: Sword cultivator in white robes pursues closely behind on glowing azure flying sword, cutting through swirling vapor trails. [Look] High-fantasy cinematic martial arts aesthetic, warm golden hour backlighting, realistic cloth physics and misty atmospheric depth. Audio: Fierce mountain wind roaring, supersonic fabric flapping, faint resonant hum of celestial flying sword.

segments.title: Part 2 (5-10s): Talisman Blast & Golden Seals / 凌空掐訣・萬符爆散
segments.prompt: Create a 5-second live-action cinematic film continuing seamlessly from the exact last frame and pose. [Scene] Open airspace above a massive mountain gorge surrounded by sheer vertical granite walls. [Camera] Dynamic 360-degree orbital rotation keeping the talisman cultivator centered while the background spins dizzyingly. Timeline: 0-2.0s: Talisman cultivator pivots gracefully in mid-air, hands rapidly weaving arcane mudra seals. 2.0-5.0s: Flings a fan of crimson paper talismans that instantly burst into blazing golden flame dragons, roaring across the sky toward the pursuer. [Look] Dazzling volumetric golden light illuminating mist droplets, fiery particle sparks swirling violently. Audio: Sharp chanting cadence, paper snapping like thunder, thunderous roar of sacred flames.

segments.title: Part 3 (10-15s): Sword Arc Cleaving the Sky / 拔劍橫掃・劍氣斷雲
segments.prompt: Create a 5-second live-action cinematic film continuing seamlessly from the exact last frame and pose. [Scene] Sky above jagged mountain peaks illuminated by exploding golden talismans. [Camera] Extreme wide shot tracking backward rapidly, then snapping into dynamic low-angle tilted view. Timeline: 0-2.5s: White-robed sword cultivator leaps from flying sword, drawing shimmering crystal longsword from scabbard with blinding flash. 2.5-5.0s: Slashes a massive 50-meter crescent of azure sword energy, violently bisecting the golden flame dragons and tearing open a canyon in the cloud sea. [Look] Electric azure blade glow, vapor shockwave rippling through clouds, lens flare on steel edge. Audio: Crisp high-pitch metallic ring of drawing sword, explosive sonic boom as energy crescent cleaves the clouds.

segments.title: Part 4 (15-20s): Canyon Dive & Mid-Air Collision (Anchor Reset) / 絕壁俯衝・近身交鋒 (關鍵幀重錨定)
segments.prompt: [Scene] Narrow, shadowy chasm between two towering sheer cliffs covered in ancient pine trees. [Camera] Vertiginous vertical dive tracking camera shot plunging straight down the cliff face alongside the fighters. Timeline: 0-2.5s: Both cultivators dive at breakneck speed down the abyss, robes fluttering fiercely against mossy stone walls. 2.5-5.0s: Collide mid-air: talisman shield clashes against glowing sword blade in brilliant golden-blue blast, sending shockwaves shattering nearby rocks. [Look] Dramatic shadows in canyon depth contrasted with blinding divine clash illumination, falling rubble particles. Audio: Rushing wind whistling in ears, thunderous metallic impact blast, cracking stone reverberating across gorge.

segments.title: Part 5 (20-25s): Celestial Bagua vs Sword Array Climax / 太極陣起・千劍歸宗
segments.prompt: Create a 5-second live-action cinematic film continuing seamlessly from the exact last frame and pose. [Scene] Summit plateau above clouds with distant setting sun hanging on mountain horizon. [Camera] Grand pull-back crane shot ascending into wide panoramic vista, capturing the massive magical spectacle. Timeline: 0-2.5s: Talisman cultivator ascends into sky, expanding giant luminous gold Bagua diagram across entire airspace. 2.5-5.0s: Sword cultivator points fingers to heaven, summoning thousands of glowing spirit sword replicas spiraling into cosmic vortex around the peaks. [Look] Epic grand scale, golden and turquoise energy vortexes lighting up evening cloud sea, divine cinematic grandeur. Audio: Deep reverberating sacred chime, thousand whistling sword blades swarming like locusts, surging cosmic crescendo.
